name: daniel profile
summary: Daniel's complete workstation, expressed as a composition of reusable components. It holds no credential and no machine identity.
manual: Restore the SSH key (see docs/secrets.md), then: ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.
Authenticate GitHub on the host: gh auth login --git-protocol ssh.
Install the Orca desktop app and open it once so it registers ~/.local/bin/orca-ide.
